title: Maximum Odd Binary Number
summary: Given a binary string s with at least one '1', rearrange the bits to form the largest possible odd binary number.
statement: Given a binary string s with at least one '1', rearrange the bits to form the largest possible odd binary number. Return the string representation of this number, which may include leading zeros.
constraints: Rearrange all bits of a binary string without adding or removing any.
The input contains at least one 1, so an odd rearrangement always exists.
Return the numerically largest odd binary string of the same length.
hints: An odd binary number must reserve one 1 for its final bit.
For the largest value, put every remaining 1 in the most significant positions.
Then place all zeros followed by the reserved final 1.
Any zero before an available prefix one makes the binary number smaller, so this arrangement is lexicographically and numerically maximal.
editorial: Any zero before an available prefix one makes the binary number smaller, so this arrangement is lexicographically and numerically maximal.

tests.explanation: The only odd arrangement with the largest leading bits is 001.
Reserve one 1 for the final odd bit and place the other 1 first, producing 1001.
